tara (PM): Quick sync. Users hit confusing behavior saving "Save for route" when org defaults exist. Need clear API + console mapping before next deploy.

alex (eng): Can you repro with a staging payload?

tara (PM): Example returned for route: `[{id:'p-42', name:'balanced', scope:'route', owner:'org-7', created_by:'svc:defaults'}]` Console showed org badge and disabled edits.

ken (platform): Root cause: we conflate `owner` and `origin`. Propose adding `editable_by` and `provenance` fields to the preset response.

nina (design): UX: show "Inherited" badge when provenance==org_default and show tooltip "Edit Org defaults". When route overrides, show "Overrides Org default" with a small diff link.

sam (sre): Telemetry: expand `preset.save` event to include `prev_effective_id`, `new_effective_id`, and `preview_cost_delta`. Add alert when delta >15%.

alex (eng): Rollout plan: add fields read-only, client reads new fields behind `preset_provenance_v1` flag, flip UI after 2 weeks. Keep `owner` for 30 days for compat and add header `X-Presets-Schema:v2-preview`.

ken (platform): I'll open PR with shim and compatibility header. Will include `fallback_model_id` if there are capacity fallbacks.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview started for platform/presets-shim at 2025-10-21T11:02:00Z

tara (PM): Action items: ken PR today, nina tooltip copy by EOD, alex tests + flag, sam alerts/dashboard. Quick 10-min follow-up tomorrow.

alex (eng): Ack, adding unit tests and contract checks.
